critique: The piece commits to its high-key brief: a sunlit linen-and-turquoise ground holds a dense tumbling-block honeycomb in which two drifting softening lenses sag the shared-vertex mesh, flush the plaster facets to chrome yellow and cobalt, and stretch each ivory sundial into a dripping vermilion Dalí tongue, while a tiny red-coated De Chirico figure under the loggia arch sets the vault's surreal scale. The melt itself is timid. A maximum 36px sag on the half-resolution canvas leaves the isometric cubes reading as a gently wobbling Escher/Vasarely pattern rather than an impossible space, and drawing at 540×960 and upscaling 2× will soften the violet contours and the roughly 12px dials that carry the surreal idea.
